title: Fixture quiz: units and time (SYNTHETIC)
purpose: Test input for the engine. Six items with one certain answer each.

questions.text: How many minutes are there in one day?

options.explain: 3,600 is the number of seconds in one hour.
86,400 is the number of seconds in one day.

questions.text: How many metres are there in 2.5 kilometres?

options.explain: That treats a kilometre as 100 metres. A kilometre is 1,000 metres.
That is 25 kilometres, ten times too many.
The half kilometre is 500 metres, not 50.

questions.text: How many days does February have in a leap year?

options.explain: 28 is February in an ordinary year.
A leap year adds one day to February, making 29.

questions.text: Which of these numbers are even?

options.explain: 14 is 2 times 7, so it is even.
21 is 3 times 7 and leaves a remainder of 1 when halved.
36 is 2 times 18, so it is even.

questions.text: Which of these are multiples of 3?

options.explain: 20 divided by 3 leaves a remainder of 2.
